name: Daily Delivery
summary: Einar Stonegrip keeps to the Wetlands while his hides make their way to Menethil Harbor. He asks travelers bound for town to carry cured crocolisk hides to a local tanner.

sections.title: A Reluctant Courier
sections.body: Einar Stonegrip hunts the wildlife of the Wetlands, especially the aggressive crocolisks along its waterways. He gathers plenty of valuable skins, but taking them home means traveling to Menethil Harbor. With his marriage to Sida going through a rough patch, Einar would rather remain in the field than face her. He hands his parcels to travelers passing toward town.

sections.title: Commerce in Menethil
sections.body: James Halloran tans hides in Menethil Harbor. Local hunters supply him with leather for boots and goods that merchants and sailors passing through the port can use. Einar has been away for a week, and Halloran guesses a quarrel with Sida explains the delivery by proxy. He wonders if his own wife should step in and make peace with her.

faq.q: Why doesn't Einar Stonegrip deliver the skins himself?
faq.answer: Einar says his wife, Sida, has been in foul humor lately. He stays in the Wetlands and asks passing travelers to carry his deliveries into Menethil Harbor to avoid facing her temper.
James Halloran tans leather in Menethil Harbor. He buys raw pelts and hides from local trappers, then cures them and sells boots and finished leather goods.
Sida is Einar Stonegrip's wife, and she lives in Menethil Harbor. Her sour mood is why Einar stays in the marshes instead of going home.

faq.q: What kind of skins are being transported?
faq.answer: The bundle holds crocolisk skins taken from the large reptiles in the Wetlands' bogs and waterways.

faq.q: Does Halloran know why Einar is avoiding Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Yes. When you hand over the bundle, Halloran says Einar has not visited in nearly a week and guesses trouble with Sida is the cause.

faq.q: Where does this delivery take place?
faq.answer: The delivery starts with Einar Stonegrip along a road in the Wetlands and ends at James Halloran's workshop in Menethil Harbor on the western coast.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you pass through Menethil Harbor, the maritime gateway between Ironforge's domain and the northern continents. Crocolisk leather helps outfit local guards and dockhands.
As a dwarf, you make your trade in the Wetlands' lowlands, far from Ironforge. Einar's trouble at home keeps him in the marshes, where he hunts crocolisks and sends travelers with his hides.
